scope: Static standalone TrueType post 1.0 GSUB/ToUnicode mapping; no shaping engine or subsetting replacement
preservation: Numerical glyph identity connects cmap and GSUB without reconstructing standard Macintosh glyph names
Ambiguous sequences and unencoded components keep the established unknown policy
Only generated PDF ToUnicode changes; glyph programs and painted pixels are unchanged in the finite fixtures
Shared face validation, GSUB work budgets and cooperative cancellation remain active
limitations: Synthetic owned fixtures; not acceptance of every independent TrueType font or renderer
Existing fontTools fallback retained for unsupported or malformed profiles
No removal of optional fonts extra or actual fontTools subsetting
